'''Altratonne Prime''' was a [[Star/Legends|star]] at the center of the [[Altratonne system/Legends|Altratonne system]]. The solar flares emitted from the star regularly showed the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altratonne]] in ionic storms. During the storms, all communications would come to a halt.
